    PC 02

    PC 02 What holds the TV

    Poured concrete eats drywall anchors.

    Pick your wall. Each one gets its own anchor, and the anchor decides the drill. Sample pricing

    1. WALL 01Drywall on studs

      Drywall

      Lag bolts into two studs. Never a plastic plug on its own.

      $139–$219 up to 75 in. Sample

    2. WALL 02Plaster & lath

      Plaster & lath

      Pilot holes first so the plaster keys don’t crack, then lags through the lath into the stud.

      Priced from a photo of the wall.

      Text a photo

    3. WALL 03Brick, two wythes

      Brick

      Sleeve anchors in the mortar joint, not the face of the brick, so nothing spalls.

      $199–$329 hammer drill and sleeve anchors Sample

    4. WALL 04Poured concrete

      Poured concrete

      Hammer drill, then sleeve anchors set to depth. Most tower walls in Jersey City are this.

      $199–$329 hammer drill and sleeve anchors Sample

    PC 03 How a visit goes

    The visit, in four moves.

    1. 01

      Make the list

      Tap it in above, or text a photo of the box labels and the wall.

    2. 02

      Get one number

      We call back with the total and ask about the elevator, the stairs and the wall.

    3. 03

      We bring the drill

      The van carries what a Jersey City wall asks for.

      • Hammer drill
      • 4 ft level
      • Stud finder
      • Sleeve anchors
      • Toggles & lags
    4. 04

      Built, tested, boxes out

      Drawers run, the bed takes weight, the treadmill runs before we go, and the cardboard leaves with us.

    386 reviews · out of 5 Sample rating

    • TV mounting on any wall · Jersey City

      Tower apartment, poured concrete walls. Two other companies said drywall anchors would be fine. Marisela's installer brought a hammer drill and sleeve anchors, and the 65-inch TV has not moved a millimeter.

      Rocco D. Sample review

    • Furniture assembly by the piece · Jersey City

      I counted seven items on the website, got a price, and the final bill matched it. Our management office needed an insurance certificate and they emailed it the same afternoon I asked.

      Ifeoma N. Sample review

    • Gym equipment · Union City

      Fourth-floor walk-up in the Heights. He carried the treadmill box up himself, built it in our tiny spare room, and ran it for five minutes to check the belt before leaving.

      Vikram R. Sample review

    • Beds, cribs and bunk beds · Hoboken

      Bed, crib, glider and a bookcase strapped to the wall, done in one evening after work. The receipt listed each piece with its time, which I liked.

      Gianna P. Sample review

    • Home office desks and chairs · Weehawken

      Two desks, two chairs and a monitor arm each. Cables zip-tied under the desks, and every cardboard box went down to the curb with them.

      Lukas M. Sample review

    • Shelves, mirrors and art · Bayonne

      Heavy mirror on an old brick wall in a Bayonne two-family. He drilled the mortar joint instead of the brick and explained why. Quick, tidy, fair price.

      Desiree T. Sample review

    • Sofas and sectionals · Jersey City

      Booked online on Monday for Thursday night, which was the only time the freight elevator was free. They arrived on time and finished before the building's 9 pm quiet hours.
